view.subtitle: THE ANCHOR-WIELDING SPACE ADMIRAL
view.intro: An iron-clad admiral with a trusty anchor and a taste for tea. Hook into the action, tether an enemy to Homboldt, and let your crew finish the job.
view.briefing: Swiggins excels with backup. Check enemy crowd control before hooking in, then coordinate a tether with nearby allies.
view.abilities_intro: Homboldt changes how Swiggins fights. Carry the anchor for melee attacks and Anchor Hook; drop it to tether an enemy and switch to Ink Spray.

tactics.title: Playing as Swiggins
tactics.text: Anchor Hook commits you to close range. Check your team's position before diving. Recover Homboldt after dropping it to regain Anchor Swing and access to Anchor Hook.

tactics.title: Playing with Swiggins
tactics.text: Stay nearby and follow up when he catches an enemy. Protect the anchor when it is safe to help him retrieve it.

tactics.title: Playing against Swiggins
tactics.text: Destroying Homboldt can free a tethered target. Traps and crowd control can punish his approach; without his anchor, his damage potential drops.

story.text: Charles Swiggins grew up on Titan as the youngest of thirty siblings in a naval family. After graduating from Wet Point, he took command of the Royal Fleet's Sweet Homboldt.
His encounter with Captain Inkbeard's Colossus left both ships wrecked. In the final fight, Swiggins seized his ship's anchor and used it to defeat the pirate captain.
Now an admiral, he carries Homboldt into space as a member of the Awesomenauts.
A NAUT MADE BY THE COMMUNITY
Swiggins originated in the 2012 Design-Your-Naut contest. Channfree created the winning concept; Coffeybean4 won the subsequent visual design contest.

skin_descriptions.default: The Royal Fleet uniform, captain’s cap and glass tank. Swiggins carries Homboldt, the anchor from his old ship.
skin_descriptions.SWIGGINS, PHD: Inspired by Dr. Fetus from Super Meat Boy: a tiny pilot inside a glass tank, mechanical tentacles, a dark suit and tie, a top hat and monocle. Homboldt wears bandages.
skin_descriptions.ABYSSAL SWIGGINS: A deep-sea creature with red eyes and a forehead glyph, without the usual cap or glass tank. Faces decorate the claw, armor and anchor; a tentacle replaces the hook chain. Includes an altered voice set.
